Definition (EN): a statement that one accepts blame for a crime
Quote from Episode: this is not an admission of guilt
Example Sentence: His signed confession was read as an admission of guilt.
例句翻译: 他签字的口供被当作了认罪。
Usage Note: 法律固定搭配；guiltless / not guilty 才是无罪。

Definition (EN): to catch or arrest someone officially
Quote from Episode: we apprehended three individuals and placed them into custody
台词翻译: 我们逮捕了三名嫌疑人并将其收押。
Example Sentence: Two men were apprehended after the raid.
例句翻译: 突袭后有两名男子被捕。
Usage Note: 常用被动式 be apprehended by；名词 apprehension 指「理解」时读 /ˌæprɪˈhenʃən/。

Definition (EN): held by police, not yet sentenced
Example Sentence: He's been in custody since March.
例句翻译: 他自三月起一直被羁押。
Usage Note: take someone into custody 为「逮捕」；in prison 指已服刑。

Definition (EN): to reduce something noticeably
释义（中文）: 给…造成打击；使…明显下降
Quote from Episode: put this big a dent in the local drug trade
台词翻译: 对本地毒品交易造成这么大冲击。
Example Sentence: The new cameras put a real dent in speeding.
例句翻译: 新摄像头让超速明显减少。
Usage Note: 也说 make a dent in；big a dent 为强调语气。

Definition (EN): observing an experienced person at work
Quote from Episode: I'll take you on a ride-along
Example Sentence: He did a few ride-alongs before carrying a weapon.
例句翻译: 在配枪前他先随行观摩过几次。
Usage Note: 警务与军队用语；搭配 go on a ride-along。

Definition (EN): false or imitation, as a prefix
Quote from Episode: That faux-Lalique vase I picked up at the Super-Swap
台词翻译: 那是我在二手店淘的仿拉利克花瓶。
Example Sentence: The counter was faux-marble.
例句翻译: 台面是仿大理石的。
Usage Note: 读 /foʊ/，不读 /fjuː/；常见 faux-leather、faux-fur。

Definition (EN): to reach a set savings minimum
Example Sentence: Few households have savings to meet their reserve.
例句翻译: 很少有家庭的储蓄能达到自定的储备线。
Usage Note: 经济与保险用语；近义 break even。

Definition (EN): unable to be treated by surgery
Example Sentence: The tumour is inoperable, so chemo is the only option.
例句翻译: 肿瘤无法手术，化疗是唯一选择。
Usage Note: 反义 operable；名词 inoperability。

Definition (EN): the most favourable possible outcome
Quote from Episode: Best-case scenario, with chemo, I'll live maybe another couple years.
台词翻译: 最理想的情况下，加上化疗我大概还能活两三年。
Example Sentence: Even in the best-case scenario it takes a year.
例句翻译: 即便最理想也要一年。
Usage Note: 对应 worst-case scenario；正式写作常用。

Definition (EN): lacking enough staff to work properly
Example Sentence: We're shorthanded; please reschedule.
例句翻译: 我们人手不足，请改期。
Usage Note: 职场书面语，口语说 understaffed。

Definition (EN): to clean a surface with a damp cloth
Quote from Episode: I need you to do some wipe-downs.
台词翻译: 我需要你去做一些擦拭。
Scene / Context: Bogdan to Walt, car wash lot
Example Sentence: The checklist ends with a wipe-down of the counter.
例句翻译: 清单最后一项是擦拭台面。
Usage Note: 服务业常用，口语拼作 wipe down；名词 wipe-down。

Definition (EN): official permission to go ahead
Example Sentence: The board gave the plan the green light.
例句翻译: 董事会批准了这个方案。
Usage Note: give / get the green light；反义 red light；注意冠词 the。

Definition (EN): said to acknowledge a message is understood
Example Sentence: Radio check, copy that.
例句翻译: 通讯测试，收到。
Usage Note: 无线电确认用语，口语常缩为 copy。

Definition (EN): to surrender oneself to police
Quote from Episode: Either that or I turn you in.
台词翻译: 要么合伙，要么我把你交出去。
Example Sentence: He turned himself in after three days.
例句翻译: 三天后他去自首了。
Usage Note: 此处重音落在 in；「交作业」的 turn in 重音在 turn。

Definition (EN): to develop into or come to amount to
Quote from Episode: I never expected you to amount to much
台词翻译: 我从没指望你能有什么出息。
Example Sentence: He started as a dishwasher and ended up running the kitchen.
例句翻译: 他从洗碗工做起，最后管起了后厨。
Usage Note: amount to nothing 即「没出息」；带轻微失望意味。

Definition (EN): to tell someone rudely to go away
Quote from Episode: You ain't Welcome Back Kotter, so step off.
台词翻译: 你那套《回到科特威尔》收起来吧，走开。
Example Sentence: I said I'm not interested. Step off.
例句翻译: 我说没兴趣，走开。
Usage Note: 带轻蔑，不是中性的 step off the gas。

Definition (EN): a very brief remark, often ironic
释义（中文）: 简短发言；（反讽）三言两语
Example Sentence: He gave his acceptance as a two-line speech.
例句翻译: 他用两句话作了个简短发言。
Usage Note: 单独说 short speech 常带「我说完了，就这些」的不耐烦。

Definition (EN): to evaluate the quality of someone's work
Quote from Episode: I could critique it for you
Example Sentence: She critiqued the draft and returned it an hour later.
例句翻译: 她批评了一遍草稿，一小时后还回来。
Usage Note: 及物用法 critique something；也可作名词。

Definition (EN): someone unable to cope, said lightly
Quote from Episode: You're gonna be a complete basket case.
台词翻译: 到时候你整个人都要崩了。
Example Sentence: By finals he was a total basket case.
例句翻译: 期末他整个人都是崩的。
Usage Note: 源自1918年流感时的旧分类标签；比 nervous wreck 更夸张。

Definition (EN): emotional upheaval in middle age
Example Sentence: The novel is about a mid-life crisis.
例句翻译: 这部小说写的是中年危机。
Usage Note: 形容词 mid-life；也常说 male mid-life crisis。

Definition (EN): the highlight of a series
Quote from Episode: But the pièce de résistance: a round bottom boiling flask.
Example Sentence: The final lecture was the pièce de résistance.
例句翻译: 最后那堂课是压轴。
Usage Note: 法语借词，字面「抵抗之物」；重音在 ré。

Definition (EN): substances added to dilute a product
Example Sentence: The lab closed for adding adulterants.
例句翻译: 那家实验室因掺杂物被查封。
Usage Note: 食品与药品监管用语；动词 adulterate。

Definition (EN): a distinctive personal touch
Example Sentence: The extra garlic is her signature.
例句翻译: 多加蒜是她的招牌。
Usage Note: 此处是「个人风格」义，不是「签名」。

Definition (EN): don't take risks in your own home turf
释义（中文）: 别在自己地盘上干有风险的事
Quote from Episode: I don't shit where I eat.
台词翻译: 我不干那种在自己家搞事的事。
Example Sentence: Don't shit where you eat—keep the books clean.
例句翻译: 别在自己地盘上冒险，账目要干净。
Usage Note: 源自工程与军队俚语；粗俗但常见的商业警句。

Definition (EN): deliberately vague to avoid the question
Example Sentence: His answer was evasive.
例句翻译: 他的回答含糊其辞。
Usage Note: 动词 evade；商务与法律常用。

Definition (EN): a remote rural area
Quote from Episode: drive way out in the boonies
Example Sentence: They bought a place in the boonies.
例句翻译: 他们在荒郊买了房子。
Usage Note: 美式口语，正式用 remote countryside。

Definition (EN): does not make sense to me
Example Sentence: The numbers add up but the story doesn't compute.
例句翻译: 数字对得上，但事说不通。
Usage Note: 用计算比喻思维，1960年代起流行。

Definition (EN): it is getting late; hurry up
Example Sentence: Daylight's burning—pack up.
例句翻译: 天快黑了，收东西。
Usage Note: 原指伐木工收工；现等于 time is running out。

Definition (EN): something very good or impressive
Example Sentence: Her presentation was the bomb.
例句翻译: 她的演讲太棒了。
Usage Note: 1990年代美式俚语，略显老派。

Definition (EN): completely flat; said humorously
Example Sentence: The bread came out flat as a washboard.
例句翻译: 面包烤得跟搓板一样。
Usage Note: 双关，也用来形容毫无起伏。

Definition (EN): the weapon or bag you normally carry
Example Sentence: He only carries one knife—his daily carry.
例句翻译: 他只带一把刀，那就是他的随身装备。
Usage Note: 源自 EDC（everyday carry）文化。

Definition (EN): to bring enough force to finish the job
释义（中文）: 带上足够的家伙；备足筹码
Quote from Episode: If you're gonna bring a gun, you gotta bring enough gun.
Example Sentence: He brought enough gun to outlast them.
例句翻译: 他备足了火力撑过他们。
Usage Note: gun 为「实力」比喻，源自枪械。

Definition (EN): a short speech praising someone with a raised glass
Quote from Episode: A little toast to my brother-in-law.
Example Sentence: He raised his glass for a toast.
例句翻译: 他举杯祝酒。
Usage Note: make / propose a toast。

Definition (EN): a simile for being slow-witted
Quote from Episode: you got a brain the size of Wisconsin
台词翻译: 你脑子就威斯康星州那么大。
Example Sentence: He has a brain the size of a pea.
例句翻译: 他脑子只有豌豆大。
Usage Note: 英语里常见的「笨蛋」谚语模式。

Definition (EN): good-hearted despite flaws
Quote from Episode: your heart's in the right place
Example Sentence: He's clumsy but his heart's in the right place.
例句翻译: 他笨手笨脚但心眼不坏。
Usage Note: 近义 have good intentions；反义 have a cold heart。

Definition (EN): judging by the current pace
Quote from Episode: At this rate, in 50 or 60 years, you'll be rich.
台词翻译: 照这个速度五六十年你就富了。
Example Sentence: At this rate we'll miss the deadline.
例句翻译: 照这样我们赶不上期限。
Usage Note: 后接 will / won't 结果。

Definition (EN): provided the terms are favourable
Example Sentence: We'll move if the price is right.
例句翻译: 价钱合适我们就搬。
Usage Note: 谈判套话，不真的只谈价钱。

Definition (EN): to be self-righteous and uptight
Example Sentence: He's all sticks-up-his-ass about paperwork.
例句翻译: 他对文件手续一本正经得不得了。
Usage Note: 动词 stick it up your ass 意为「别那么拘谨」，与形容词相反。

Definition (EN): to suddenly turn to wrongdoing
Example Sentence: Two good neighbourhoods broke bad in a decade.
例句翻译: 两个好社区十年里就堕落了。
Usage Note: 剧名由此而来；区别 break down（出故障）。

Definition (EN): to inform on someone
Quote from Episode: He thinks maybe you dimed on him.
Example Sentence: Nobody dimed on anyone.
例句翻译: 没人出卖谁。
Usage Note: 近义 rat on someone；与名词 dime（角币）无关。

Definition (EN): an offensive word for an informer
Example Sentence: He thought his partner was a ratasnitch.
例句翻译: 他以为搭档是告密的。
Usage Note: 近义 snitch、informant；带强烈侮辱色彩。

Definition (EN): there is no time to waste; hurry
Example Sentence: Ain't got all day, the train leaves in twenty.
例句翻译: 没时间了，车二十分钟后开。
Usage Note: 正式说法 hurry up；ain't 为非标准缩合。

Definition (EN): to exclude from information or feelings
Example Sentence: He shut her out after the second year.
例句翻译: 他大二之后就把她排除在外了。
Usage Note: shut someone out of something。

Definition (EN): with extra force and determination
Example Sentence: He returned to the ring with a vengeance.
例句翻译: 他重返拳坛，杀气十足。
Usage Note: 来自圣经「报复」意象；加强语气。

Definition (EN): to be released on bond
Example Sentence: He made bail after his arraignment.
例句翻译: 他在传讯后获得保释。
Usage Note: 法律用语；post bail 为缴纳保释金。

Definition (EN): to fail a course
Example Sentence: He flunked chemistry twice.
例句翻译: 他化学挂过两次。
Usage Note: 非正式；正式用 fail。

Definition (EN): a mask protecting the lungs from fumes
Example Sentence: Meth labs require full-face respirators.
例句翻译: 制毒实验室需要全脸防护呼吸器。
Usage Note: 比 mask 专业；动词 respire。
